name: locus
description: Agent skills for finding, initializing, tracking, and distilling owned knowledge and active repository work.

interface.shortDescription: Find knowledge and track active work.
interface.longDescription: Locus finds relevant repository knowledge and active work, creates or refreshes canonical docs, tracks repository work across local and GitHub surfaces, and distills transient evidence into durable owned knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Choose the smallest relevant Locus workflow.
Find or maintain owned knowledge and active work.
Track repository work or distill verified evidence when needed.
